notes: Panel and overlay polish. Panel: the 30 / 60 fps setting no longer animates hidden pages (about a quarter less CPU); the Settings preview pauses while the panel is behind the game; sound sleeps when idle; the overlay background slider no longer jumps back while you drag it; "Remove key" keeps its warning while armed; typing an amount is no longer interrupted by a save reload; Give, Set up and key buttons cannot be sent twice from the keyboard; Build Creator progress and errors redraw correctly; in a narrow window all tabs show (no hidden tabs or stray bar); the intro skip works after other keys. Overlay (launcher 1.6.12): it no longer stays open if Windows reuses the closed game's window for another program.
